name: nwrmp
description: National Water Resource Management Platform - Ministry of Water Development

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix apps/api install && npm --prefix apps/web install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,blue "npm --prefix apps/api run dev" "npm --prefix apps/web run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix apps/api run build && npm --prefix apps/web run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix apps/api run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/web run typecheck
